fences.rule: If the writer itself reads the file back and the only loss is what the carrier changed on the way down and back, it is Read back from disk there; if the predecessor is gone and a stranger reads what was left, it is here.
fences.case: A file written at a chosen seam for a reader who will not be its writer, so that a kill or a compaction strips only what came after the seam.

fences.rule: If the successor's not-knowing is the point and the loss is a yield, the blind judge or the fresh critic, it is there; if the loss is a price the successor would refund if it could, it is here.
fences.case: The critic seat denied the author's reasoning and given only the record and the ledger.

fences.rule: If the reasoner is still present and the thing lies past the edge of its live window, it is there; if the predecessor is gone and the successor reads what was left, it is here.
fences.case: The reasoner's own earlier artifact on disk, exact and complete, met after a closing by the same reasoner with its reasons never written anywhere.

fences.rule: A list that stops at its own publication, taking the printed form as the end, is Published as finished there; an artifact that carries its own position in the succession so the successor knows which stage it is at is Stage stamp here.
fences.case: A record marked 'pending critic admission', which tells a critic it has not been read and a repairer that it has.

fences.rule: If a name's form fixes what one item is, it is Two-slot name there; if the name's form survives the crossing and its resolver does not, so the successor's whole yield turns on whether its environment resolves it, it is Name that resolves here.
fences.case: A slug in a handoff note whose environment on the successor's side does not resolve it.

fences.rule: If a device left behind, a vector clock or a dated contract, carries order or a deadline across windows, it is there; if nothing dated crossed and the successor infers order or an ending from the environment's state, it is here.
fences.case: A lease with a time-to-live held by a predecessor that died, whose expiry tells the successor how long ago the end came and nothing about whether the write it held the lease for was finished.
